districts.name: Dojo Valley
steps: Meet the dojo mentor and learn movement.
Complete the reed-path course and lantern timing drill.
Finish a guided spar and return to the dojo.

districts.name: Tideharbor Coast
districts.landmark: Harbor paths, tide pools and shipwreck overlook
steps: Find the harbor instructor and activate the shore marker.
Carry training parcels across the tide-path route.
Complete the harbor practice encounter and report back.

districts.name: Cinder Terraces
districts.landmark: Kiln workshops, steam lifts and ceramic gardens
steps: Meet the keeper and inspect three marked vents.
Solve the bellows timing puzzle to restore the lift.
Complete the workshop spar and return the repaired training tile.

districts.name: Skywalk Peaks
districts.landmark: Wind bridges, cliff paths and the cloud temple
steps: Reach the wind court using its marked accessible route.
Activate the bridge switches through a movement challenge.
Complete the temple practice encounter and reconnect the route.

districts.name: Frostglass Gardens
districts.landmark: Ice gardens, warm shelters and frozen ponds
steps: Find the caretaker and survey three garden markers.
Complete the sliding course and light puzzle.
Finish the garden training trial and report back.

districts.name: Lantern Circuit
districts.landmark: Neon courtyards, rooftop paths and a night market
steps: Meet the instructor and discover the rooftop route.
Complete a signal-routing puzzle and delivery challenge.
Finish the circuit practice encounter and open the night display.

trophies.name: First Footing
